tasks.title: Create flow, alias, expiry, URL safety
tasks.description: Audit and complete POST /api/urls: JSON/400 handling, 7-char codes, alias validation and 409, expiry past/365-day checks, URL safety validation (scheme, userinfo, length, localhost, private/mapped IPs), token generation with hash storage, Location header.
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated validators, service and endpoint for creation
tasks.validation: Build passes; creation acceptance criteria satisfied by T4 tests

tasks.title: Redirect, metadata, analytics, delete
tasks.description: Ensure GET /r/{code}, legacy GET /{code}, metadata, analytics (and /stats), and DELETE with X-Owner-Token (401/403/404/204 idempotent) behave per spec; atomic click counting only on successful redirects; no token or hash in metadata.
tasks.validation: Build passes; 1000 concurrent redirects yield totalClicks 1000

tasks.title: Per-IP creation rate limiter
tasks.description: Make limit configurable (default 10/60s), applied per remote IP to POST /api/urls before validation, return 429 with Retry-After, exclude redirects, ignore forwarded headers by default, bound memory.
tasks.validation: 11th request in window returns 429 with Retry-After; different IPs independent

tasks.title: Tests for create, alias, expiry, safety
tasks.description: Write integration/unit tests for every acceptance criterion of FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-9 including 1000-create uniqueness, SSRF IP matrix, expiry boundaries (use fake time).
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes; each acceptance criterion maps to a test

tasks.title: Tests for redirect, metadata, analytics, delete
tasks.description: Test FR-4 to FR-7 including 404/410 paths, no click counting on errors, concurrent 1000 redirects, token absent from metadata, delete auth cases and idempotency, legacy routes.
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes; suite runs under 60 seconds

tasks.title: Tests for rate limiting
tasks.description: Test 429 on 11th request, Retry-After header, per-IP independence, 400/409 counting, redirects unaffected.
risks: Simulating different client IPs in test host
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes for all FR-8 criteria

tasks.title: Documentation
tasks.description: Document endpoints, owner token usage, rate-limit configuration, assumptions, and residual DNS-based SSRF/redirect risk and in-memory data loss.
tasks.validation: Docs list all routes, status codes, config keys and known risks
